Class AbstractMultiCheckedElementTag

java.lang.Object

org.springframework.web.servlet.tags.RequestContextAwareTag
org.springframework.web.servlet.tags.HtmlEscapingAwareTag

All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.DynamicAttributes, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.JspTag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.TryCatchFinally, Serializable, EditorAwareTag
Direct Known Subclasses:
CheckboxesTag, RadioButtonsTag
public abstract class AbstractMultiCheckedElementTag extends AbstractCheckedElementTag
抽象基类，用于提供实现支持数据绑定的 JSP 标签的通用方法，以渲染多个 HTML `input` 元素，其`type`为`checkbox`或`radio`。
Since:
2.5.2
Author:
Juergen Hoeller, Scott Andrews
